text: Shmuber Eats is a grocery delivery app: a household orders from a local supermarket, a picker shops the order, and it arrives in a two-hour window the same day or the next.
The beta runs in one metro area. Many households place a first order, but fewer than one in three place a second order within 30 days.
The team's bet: surprise substitutions at the door are the main reason first-time customers do not come back.
Pickers replace an out-of-stock item with the closest match they can find; the customer is notified in the app, and most see the swap only when the bags arrive.
Twelve beta households agreed to a 15-25 minute interview about their last grocery orders.
